sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. This is a strong matchup on paper—Sandbach have won 7 of their 10 games and sit 2 points clear of second-placed Stafford Town, while Alsager Town are rooted to the bottom with just 4 points and have won only once all season. Sandbach's most recent outing was a loss, but their underlying form remains excellent with 4 wins in their last 5 outings, so they should be favored to extend their lead at the summit.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face Dawley Town away on Saturday at 15:00, looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall (6th) in an intriguing mid-table clash, while Wolverhampton Casuals—fourth on 19 points—host Wednesfield Community. Bilston Town (5th) visit Foley Meir (13th), and Barnton (7th) are at home to Shawbury United (15th), who arrive in dire form having lost six consecutive matches. New Mills (8th) face Market Drayton Town (10th) away, Telford Town (18th) travel to Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th) in a basement-region battle, and Crewe (16th) entertain Allscott Heath (11th) at home. Widnes Town, bottom on just 2 points, visit Brereton Social (14th) on Saturday. Later in the week, Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community on Wednesday evening at 19:45 in a midweek fixture.
